fullPassage: "Art without commerce is a hobby." These words, spoken with much authority to several hundred students at the first of a series of "Art Talk" lectures, completely rocked my world. For the first time in my life, I had to face the fact that what I was doing was a hobby. As a kid I used to draw endlessly, using ink, acrylic, and even spray cans. But I never once thought about making a dollar from my art. Over the years, this approach of "creating for creation's sake" was reinforced by people around me, including school teachers, who would say things like, "Draw whatever your heart desires." So by the time I graduated from college, I had convinced myself that having a career in the arts meant working in a bubble, creating what I wanted to create and then hoping the world would like it. But the cold reality was that almost no one was interested in my art because it had no _______________.

det.korean: 지지나 강조를 더해 무언가를 더 강하거나 효과적으로 만들다
det.analysis:
② convince: 확신시키다 — 강화가 아닌 설득
① reinforce: 강화하다 — 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
③ graduate: 졸업하다 — 다른 의미
④ approach: 접근하다 — 다른 의미
det.tip: reinforce는 '강화하다, 보강하다'로, 본문에서 주변 사람들이 순수 창작 철학을 강화시켰다(reinforced)로 쓰였다.

questions.passage: These words, __________ with much authority to several hundred students at the first of a series of "Art Talk" lectures, completely rocked my world. (speak)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: These words, __________(speak) with much authority — 분사구문. words와 speak은 수동 관계(말이 발언되다)이므로 과거분사 spoken이 필요.
det.tip: words spoken with authority — '권위를 가지고 발언된 말들'. 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 spoken.

questions.passage: But the cold reality was that almost no one was __________ in my art because it had no _______________. (interest)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: interest(명사/동사: 관심/흥미를 갖게 하다) → interested(형용사: 관심 있는)
det.analysis: no one was __________(interest) in my art — be interested in은 '~에 관심 있다'는 관용 표현. 주어(사람)가 관심을 느끼는 것이므로 과거분사 형용사 interested.
det.tip: be interested in은 '~에 관심이 있다'. interest의 과거분사 interested가 형용사로 쓰여 사람의 감정 상태를 나타낸다.

questions.passage: "Art without commerce is a hobby." These words, spoken with much authority to several hundred students at the first of a series of "Art Talk" lectures, completely rocked my world. For the first time in my life, I had to face the fact that what I was doing was a hobby. As a kid I used to draw endlessly, using ink, acrylic, and even spray cans. But I never once thought about making a dollar from my art. Over the years, this approach of "__________" was reinforced by people around me, including school teachers, who would say things like, "Draw whatever your heart desires." So by the time I graduated from college, I had convinced myself that having a career in the arts meant working in a bubble, creating what I wanted to create and then hoping the world would like it. But the cold reality was that almost no one was interested in my art because it had no _______________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수년간 이 '___'이라는 접근 방식은 주변 사람들에 의해 강화되었다.
det.analysis:
① creating for creation's sake: 순수 창작 — 원문 그대로 ←정답
② a series of lectures: 일련의 강의 — 접근 방식이 아님
③ making a dollar: 돈 벌기 — 한 번도 생각하지 않은 것이지 접근 방식이 아님
④ whatever your heart desires: 마음이 원하는 것 — 선생님의 말이지 접근 방식의 이름이 아님
det.tip: 'creating for creation's sake'는 '창작을 위한 창작'으로, 상업성 없이 순수하게 창작하는 태도를 뜻한다.

det.korean: 예술 분야에서 경력을 갖는 것은 ___을 의미했다.
det.analysis:
① working in a bubble: 고립된 환경에서 일하기 — 원문 그대로 ←정답
② drawing endlessly: 끝없이 그리기 — 어린 시절 행동이지 경력의 의미가 아님
③ facing the fact: 사실을 직시하기 — 경력의 의미가 아닌 강의 후 깨달음
④ having a career in the arts: 예술 분야 경력 — 순환적 정의
det.tip: working in a bubble은 '거품 속에서 일하다'로, 외부 시장과 단절된 채 자기만의 세계에서 창작하는 것을 의미.
